title: Home Mortgage Loans: adjustable-rate fixed period, adjustment interval, index and margin

# Home Mortgage Loans: adjustable-rate fixed period, adjustment interval, index and margin

This document lists the rate structure settings of the Home Mortgage Loans programs: how long the initial rate is fixed, how many months pass between rate adjustments after the fixed period, which rate index is used, and the margin added to that index.

## Settings by program

| Program | Initial rate fixed for (months) | Months between adjustments after the fixed period | Rate index | Margin added to the index (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 84 | 6 | 30-day average SOFR | 2.75 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |

"Not applicable" means the program sets no value for that setting. Only the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage sets them.

## 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage at a glance

- **Initial fixed period:** 84 months, which is seven years.
- **Adjustment interval after the fixed period:** every 6 months.
- **Rate index:** the 30-day average SOFR.
- **Margin:** 2.75 percentage points added to the index.

## Basis Q&A

- **How many adjustments fall in each year after the fixed period?** With an interval of 6 months, two adjustments fall in each twelve-month span after the fixed period ends.
- **Do the fixed-rate programs have an index or margin?** No. The five fixed-rate programs set no fixed period, adjustment interval, index or margin.
